headline: Copper overtakes iron ore as profit engine, margins expand
summary_short: BHP's FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) revenue rose 15% y/y to $58,760M and underlying EBITDA rose 27% y/y to $32.9B; underlying attributable profit grew 30% y/y to $13.2B while the statutory profit measure rose a smaller 9% y/y to $9,833M on exceptional items.
summary_long: Full-year revenue was $58,760M (+15% y/y). Underlying EBITDA was $32.9B (+27% y/y); underlying attributable profit was $13.2B (+30% y/y, from $10.2B). Statutory profit after tax attributable was $9,833M (+9% y/y) — the smaller statutory gain reflects exceptional items excluded from the underlying figure. ROCE improved to 26% (+6ppt y/y). Net debt was $8.7B (0.3x LTM EBITDA). The board declared a $0.99/share final dividend. Copper production was approximately 2.0 million tonnes.
